==Format==
* '''Play-In'''
** Groups
*** Two groups of 4 teams randomly seeded.
*** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
*** Winner of each group advances to Play-In Knockout.
** Knockout
*** Two teams from Play-In Group Stage randomly paired against two seeded teams from Taiwan (LMS) and Vietnam (VCS).
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
*** Winners qualify for Group Stage.
* '''Group Stage'''
** Two teams from Play In and four seeded teams from Korea (LCK), China (LPL), North America (NA LCS) and Europe (EU LCS).
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
** Top four teams advance to Knockout Stage
* '''Knockout Stage'''
** Four teams Single Elimination
** 1st place team from Group Stage selects either the 3rd place or 4th place team as their opponent.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}

==Prize Pool==
The base prize pool of the tournament was $250,000 {{Abbr/USD}}.
<br /> 25% of the total sales from the Conqueror Varus and the 2018 Conqueror ward skin will contribute to the MSI prize pool from April 26-May 20.
<br /> Guaranteed to be at least $750,000 from the Conqueror Varus and 2018 Conqueror ward skin, for a total prize pool of at least $1,000,000.

The current total prize pool (as of 20 May 2018) is $1,370,520 {{Abbr/USD}}.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/998140068517875712|title=Total MSI prize pool - 20 May, 2018 |author=@lolesports |date=2018-05-11 |language={{Flag|usuk}}}}</ref><!--<ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/994917721585389568|title=Total MSI prize pool - 11 May, 2018 |author=@lolesports |date=2018-05-11 |language={{Flag|usuk}}}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/993067667123834880 |title=Total MSI prize pool - 6 May, 2018 |author=@lolesports |date=2018-05-06 |language={{Flag|usuk}}}}</ref>-->
